data.name: Bilawalun
data.gender_notes: Bilawalun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is strong and brave, a courageous leader. The name Bilawalun carries the meaning “Strong, Brave, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Bilawalun usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who possess inner strength and courage, and have the ability to lead others spiritually
data.etymology: Bilawalun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Brave, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilawalun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بلوالون
in_arabic.long_meaning: بلوالون هو اسم عربي يعني الابن الأول المولود، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يعتبر البنون ثمرة القلوب وفرحة الأهل، وهو اسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية بلو التي تعني البكر أو الأول، وله ذكر في القرآن الكريم في سياق الفرح والبشرى

in_urdu.name: بلوالون
in_urdu.long_meaning: بلوالون ایک عربی نام ہے جو پہلے پیدا ہونے والے بیٹے کے معنی میں ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں بچوں کی پیدائش کو خوشی کا موقع سمجھا جاتا ہے اور یہ نام اس خوشی کا اظہار کرتا ہے، بلوالون کا ذکر قرآن پاک میں بھی ملتا ہے جو فرح و بشری کے سیاق میں ہے

in_hindi.name: बिलावलुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: बिलावलुन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ पहले पैदा होने वाला बेटा होता है, इस्लामी संस्कृति में बच्चों के जन्म को खुशी का अवसर माना जाता है और यह नाम इस खुशी की अभिव्यक्ति करता है, बिलावलुन का उल्लेख कुरान में भी मिलता है जो खुशी और समाचार के संदर्भ में है

in_pashto.name: بلوالون

in_english.name: Bilawalun
in_english.long_meaning: Bilawalun is an Arabic name meaning firstborn son or noble child, with significant importance in Islamic culture where children are considered a blessing and a source of joy, it is derived from the Arabic word bilaw which means first or noble, and has references in the Quran in the context of joy and good news

data.cultural_impact: The name "Bilawalun" holds great cultural significance in various regions, particularly in the Islamic world. The title "Bilawal" is of Persian origin, and it has been often used to denote a person of great courage, valor, and leadership skills. Throughout history, various individuals, including poets, army commanders, and even rulers, have been known by this name. It embodies the spirit of strength, resilience, and fearlessness, which is revered in many Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Bilawalun" holds profound significance in the teachings of Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam. Sufis believe that every soul is precious and must realize its inherent potential for greatness, often referred to as "Tawwuf," or the spiritual journey towards self-realization. The name "Bilawalun" encourages the bearer to live up to its meaning and to be a courageous embodiment of the divine spirit within them. It is a reminder to confront challenges with dignity, courage, and unwavering faith, ultimately enabling spiritual growth and closeness to the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Strong, Brave, Courageous" symbolizes One who is strong and brave, a courageous leader. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Bilawalun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of strong, brave, courageous.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bilawal was a Sufi saint from the Chishti order in India in the 13th century. The name Bilawalun carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bilawal is of historical significance as it was the name of a Sufi saint from the Chishti order in India during the 13th century. Today, the name is used as a given name and can be found on various social media platforms.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Zainab Bilawalun in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Bilawalun, which means "Strong, Brave, Courageous". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
